title: Contract processed successfully
description: Emitted as the contract_processed_success event type when an asynchronous contract operation requested through the contracts API completes successfully: creation (CREATE_CONTRACT), update including renegotiation (UPDATE_CONTRACT) or termination (DELETE_CONTRACT). One event is emitted per processed contract request and carries the resulting contract state, so consumers can confirm the operation and keep their own view of the contract in sync.

contract_id.title: Contract ID
contract_id.description: Unique identifier of the contract generated by Pismo as a time-based UUID (v7) when the contract is created. For renegotiations it identifies the original contract being renegotiated.

contract_operation_id.title: Contract operation ID
contract_operation_id.description: Client-provided identifier of the credit operation, sent as credit_operation.id on creation and as operation_id on update and termination. It is unique per organization and is the key clients use to reference the contract.

ipoc_code.title: IPOC code
ipoc_code.description: Client-provided IPOC code (identifier of the credit operation in the Brazilian credit registry) associated with the contract. It is null when it was not informed.

end_date.title: End date
end_date.description: Client-provided contract end date, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd. It is null when the contract has no end date.

contract_external_id.title: Contract external ID
contract_external_id.description: Optional client-provided external identifier of the contract, with up to 40 characters. It is null when it was not informed.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Client-provided identifier of the client of the credit operation, sent as credit_operation.client_id on creation and stored as the contract operation number.

operation_amount.title: Operation amount
operation_amount.description: Total amount of the credit operation in BRL, with up to 5 decimal places, as currently stored for the contract.

guarantee_amount.title: Guarantee amount
guarantee_amount.description: Amount in BRL, with up to 5 decimal places, that the contract requires to be covered by guarantees. It is null when it was not informed.

feature_type.title: Feature type
feature_type.description: Classifies the operation that produced the event. CREATE_CONTRACT: contract creation. UPDATE_CONTRACT: contract update, including renegotiation. DELETE_CONTRACT: contract termination. CREATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: negotiable instrument act creation, not emitted by this event. UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: negotiable instrument act update, not emitted by this event. DELETE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: negotiable instrument act termination, not emitted by this event.

operation_type.title: Operation type
operation_type.description: Specializes feature_type. CREATE_CONTRACT is used for creation; UPDATE_CONTRACT_INCL, UPDATE_CONTRACT_ALTE and UPDATE_CONTRACT_EXCL map the update_type INCL (inclusion), ALTE (alteration) and EXCL (exclusion, also used for renegotiation); CANCELLATION_ERROR, CLOSING, CLOSING_DJUD and CLOSING_RNGC map the termination reasons CNOP (operational error), ENCT (regular closing), DJUD (judicial decision) and RNGC (renegotiation).

joint_debtors.title: Joint debtors
joint_debtors.description: Joint debtors currently linked to the contract, as provided by the client. It is an empty array when the contract has no joint debtors.

document_number.title: Joint debtor document number
document_number.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the joint debtor, digits only. It is omitted when empty.

name.title: Joint debtor name
name.description: Name of the joint debtor as provided by the client, with up to 100 characters. It is omitted when empty.

digital_receivable_supplement.title: Digital receivable supplement
digital_receivable_supplement.description: Digital receivable supplement (aditivo) sent with the contract operation, read from the persisted supplement. Null on renegotiation and when the contract has no supplement.

digital_receivable_supplement_id.title: Digital receivable supplement ID
digital_receivable_supplement_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID v7) of the supplement, generated by Pismo when the supplement is created.

total_amount.title: Total amount
total_amount.description: Total amount of the supplement in BRL with decimals, as defined on the contract.

available_balance.title: Available balance
available_balance.description: Remaining amount of the supplement in BRL with decimals that can still be consumed by digital receivables bound to the contract. On updates with balance capture enabled it is the previous available balance adjusted by the change in total_amount.

start_date.title: Start date
start_date.description: Start date of the supplement period, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

end_date.title: End date
end_date.description: End date of the supplement period, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

min_expire_days.title: Minimum expire days
min_expire_days.description: Minimum number of days until maturity that a digital receivable must have to be covered by the supplement.

max_expire_days.title: Maximum expire days
max_expire_days.description: Maximum number of days until maturity that a digital receivable may have to be covered by the supplement.

min_face_value.title: Minimum face value
min_face_value.description: Minimum face value in BRL with decimals that a digital receivable must have to be covered by the supplement.

max_face_value.title: Maximum face value
max_face_value.description: Maximum face value in BRL with decimals that a digital receivable may have to be covered by the supplement.

debtors.title: Debtors
debtors.description: Debtors included in or excluded from the supplement scope, as stored on the supplement. Absent when the supplement has no debtors.

document_number.title: Debtor document number
document_number.description: Document number of the debtor, either CPF or CNPJ, as informed on the contract.

document_number_prefix.title: Debtor document number prefix
document_number_prefix.description: First eight digits (CNPJ root) of the debtor document number. Present only when the debtor is identified by CNPJ; absent for CPF debtors.

operation_type.title: Debtor operation type
operation_type.description: Whether the debtor is part of the supplement scope, validated against the debtor OperationType enum on the contract API. INCL: The debtor is included in the supplement scope. EXCL: The debtor is excluded from the supplement scope.

payment.title: Payment details
payment.description: Payment instruments registered for the contract, with at most one TED account, one PIX key and one bank slip. Null when the contract has no payment details; each instrument is omitted when it is not registered.

ted.title: TED account
ted.description: Bank account registered to receive payments of the contract by TED. Omitted when not registered.

pix.title: PIX key
pix.description: PIX key registered to receive payments of the contract. Omitted when not registered.

bank_slip.title: Bank slip
bank_slip.description: Bank slip (boleto) registered for payments of the contract. Omitted when not registered.

bank_slip.title: Bank slip
bank_slip.description: Bank slip (boleto) registered as a payment method for the contract.

bar_code.title: Bar code
bar_code.description: Numeric bar code of the bank slip as provided by the client.

pix.title: PIX
pix.description: PIX key registered as a payment method for the contract.

type.title: PIX key type
type.description: Numeric code of the PIX key type: 1 for CPF, 2 for CNPJ, 3 for phone, 4 for email, 5 for random key and 6 for copy and paste (QR code).

value.title: PIX key value
value.description: Value of the PIX key, whose format depends on the key type.

ted.title: TED
ted.description: Bank account registered to receive TED transfers for the contract.

compe.title: COMPE code
compe.description: Three-digit COMPE code identifying the destination bank.

ispb.title: ISPB code
ispb.description: Eight-digit ISPB code identifying the destination financial institution in the Brazilian payment system.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Branch number of the destination bank account.

account_number.title: Account number
account_number.description: Number of the destination bank account, without the check digit.

account_digit.title: Account digit
account_digit.description: Check digit of the destination bank account.

account_type.title: Account type
account_type.description: Type of the destination bank account as provided by the client, one of the AccountType codes CC, CD, PG, PP, CCOR or CPAG.

owner_document_number.title: Owner document number
owner_document_number.description: CPF or CNPJ of the destination bank account owner, digits only.
